why: phase-483 W2 — the component trait, renamed from `nros::Node` so that `Node` names the node handle as it does in rclrs. It is the analogue of `rclcpp_components` (rclrs has no component model): a type a launch file instantiates, with per-class static entity bounds (`ENTITY_BOUNDS`), a dispatch strategy for RTIC/Embassy (`DISPATCH`) and a `register` the generated entry calls. Kept because static sizing and framework dispatch need a per-type hook; see RFC-0089 §"Settled: `nros::` is deleted from C++, and Rust takes rclrs's shape with ONE node type".
